properties.role: Tide-reader and boatwoman at pier four; only one who rows near the bell water
properties.played_as: Whispers as if the water might hear her; never meets anyone's eye, keeps her gaze on the tide line; curt, keeps mending her net
properties.wants: Never to row at night; will take two silver for the ride
properties.knows: Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang, forty years ago; her grandmother said the water came up warm

sources.quote: Sela Thorn. I read the tides. I'll row you, but not at night. Never at night.
She talks in a whisper, like the water might hear her, and she never once looks you in the eye.

changes.why: New NPC the GM voiced; dockhands say Sela or Sella, so the spelling is kept as an alias.

sources.quote: She says she'll be at pier four tomorrow at first light if you want the ride.

changes.why: Sela works at the docks, pier four.

properties.details_shown: Up the cliff path, about an hour from Gullwick. Entrance is a black mouth in the chalk, half-rotted timber frame, a rusted cart on its side. Warm air smelling of church candle wax. Thirty paces in the tunnel is flooded with warm black water; wet hymn-book pages float on it and cling to the walls.
properties.state: Closed and flooded since the night the bell first rang, forty years ago; the water is warm.

sources.quote: About thirty paces in, the tunnel floods. Black water, and it's warm to the touch.
Saltmere flooded the same night the bell first rang. Forty years ago.

changes.why: The party saw the mine; its condition is now known.

properties.what_changed: Teo found a hymn-book page in Saltmere Mine with 'M. Brand' pencilled in the margin and says it is Mira's handwriting: she was there.

sources.quote: A hymn about the sea giving back what it takes. And in the margin, in pencil, someone wrote "M. Brand".
That's Mira. That's my sister's handwriting. She was here.

changes.why: New lead on Teo's goal; the identification of the handwriting is Teo's claim.

properties.what_is_open: Dana and Priya suspect the harbor-master Maren is behind the choir; no evidence found.

sources.quote: I bet the harbor-master is behind all this. Maren wanted us gone from day one. She's in the cult, I'm calling it.

changes.why: A player suspicion the party may follow; kept as a guess, not a fact.

sources.quote: Yeah, Maren is totally running the choir.

changes.why: The suspicion is about Maren.

properties.details_shown: Sank into the bay with its bell. At low water the roof shows: just the bell tower and two broken arches, seaweed hanging from the stones. At midnight the bell rings under the water twelve times; pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor like a congregation, then vanish.
properties.state: Haunted at night; the bell and a loud humming return at midnight.

sources.quote: The drowned chapel's roof sticks out of the bay at low water, just the bell tower and two broken arches.
Shapes. Pale shapes, standing on the chapel floor under the water, in rows. Like a congregation.

changes.why: The party saw the chapel and its night apparition.

sources.quote: (to himself) That's the choir clock at three of six.

changes.why: The GM advanced the hidden clock from 2 to 3 of 6.

change.name: The Kelp Mother takes children from the shore

properties.statement: Local fishermen say the Kelp Mother pulls children down by the ankles if they stand too close to the water.

sources.quote: The Kelp Mother takes children who stand that close. Pulls them down by the ankles. Everyone knows that.
That's what the fishermen say.

changes.why: A local legend, recorded as rumor, not as a confirmed creature.

properties.played_as: Huge, red beard, laughs at his own jokes, wipes the same mug the whole time he talks
properties.wants: Looks after the party: free stew after their midnight shore trip
properties.knows: Has known Maren for thirty years

sources.quote: Bram is huge, red beard, laughs at his own jokes, and he wipes the same mug the whole time he talks to you.
You lot went to the shore at midnight? Brave or stupid. On the house, either way.

changes.why: New NPC the GM voiced.

properties.details_shown: Tavern by the docks, fire going, smells of tar and fish stew.
properties.state: The party's base; they took a long rest here.

sources.quote: You end up back at the Tarred Gull, the tavern by the docks. Fire going, it smells of tar and fish stew.

changes.why: New place the party uses as base.

sources.quote: The innkeeper, Bram, sets down three bowls of stew without being asked.

changes.why: Bram runs the Tarred Gull.

change.name: Maren lost a brother to the bay

properties.statement: Maren Vosk lost a brother to the bay, according to Bram.

sources.quote: Maren? Thirty years I've known her. Sharp tongue. Good heart. She lost a brother to that bay.

changes.why: Background on Maren that bears on the suspicion thread.

sources.quote: She lost a brother to that bay.

changes.why: The fact is about Maren.

change.name: Dive to the drowned chapel at low tide

properties.what_is_open: Teo thinks the hymns Mira wrote in came from the chapel; the party wants to see it up close.
properties.next_step: Tomorrow at first light Sela rows them out and they dive at low tide; Vessa buys rope and a second lantern tonight.

sources.quote: Mira wrote in that hymn book. The chapel is where the hymns came from. We go down to the chapel.
So tomorrow, first light, Sela rows us out and we dive to the chapel at low tide. I'll buy rope and a second lantern tonight.

changes.why: The party's agreed plan for next session.

sources.quote: Agreed. Tomorrow we dive.

changes.why: placeholder
